# Swarm Runtime

Experimental bounded worker supervisor and execution-adapter contract for the hybrid agent swarm.

- README.md: scope and quick start.
- docs/WORKER-CONTRACT.md: worker request, adapter, lifecycle and resource contract.
- docs/THREAT-MODEL.md: trust boundaries and explicit isolation limitations.
- Python API: swarm_runtime.
- This package supervises trusted adapters; it is not a sandbox and does not execute arbitrary workloads.
